agreementChunk1: You are warmly invited to be a part of this community! Our invitation to you is to come to the platform and its communities as a contributor and co-creator. We know you have a unique role to play in making this place more enjoyable and more useful for everyone. We ask all Hylo participants to commit to upholding our {{codeOfConductLink}} and {{termsOfUseLink}} by consenting to the {{fullAgreementsLink}}. We are so happy you are with us on this journey. Welcome to Hylo!
agreementChunk2: I pledge to behave on Hylo in ways that contribute to an open, welcoming, and healthy community, and to support other members in feeling respected and appreciated.
agreementChunk3: I will respect differing viewpoints and experiences, and work to find common ground and shared values with other Hylo members.
agreementChunk4: I commit to learning from every interaction. I will listen to feedback, adapt, and embrace responsibility for mistakes as opportunities for growth.
agreementChunk5: I pledge to share my voice, ideas, and skills in service to my group(s) on Hylo, recognizing that working together leads to better outcomes.
agreementChunk6: If I see an opportunity to improve something on the Hylo platform or within my group, I will take action to make it better.
agreementChunk7: I commit to upholding the {{codeOfConductLink}}, and {{termsOfUseLink}}, and I agree to participate in accountability processes when necessary.

subscriptionChange.currencyMismatch.bloc: Your current plan uses {{currentCurrency}} and this plan uses {{targetCurrency}}. Switching between different currencies isn't supported right now.

subscriptionChange.currencyMismatch.body: Your current plan is billed in {{currentCurrency}} and the new plan uses {{targetCurrency}}. We can't blend prices mid-cycle, so the new plan will start at the end of your current billing period. You keep your current access until then.
subscriptionChange.groupAccessOverlapNot: If you buy another subscription that also grants group access elsewhere, the extra group-access portion doesn't stack. You still keep any other included benefits (like tracks or roles).
subscriptionChange.immediateProrate.body: We'll update your subscription now. Your billing cycle resets to today at the new plan's price. You get a credit on this charge for the unused part of your current period (based on what you paid for that period).
subscriptionChange.invoicePreview.loadFa: Couldn't load the Stripe invoice preview. Estimated line items may be missing; charges are finalized when you confirm.
subscriptionChange.invoicePreview.totalE: Estimated total is the sum of the lines above. The credit line is unused prepaid time from your current plan. The subscription line is the new plan for the billing period starting today. Amounts are finalized when you confirm; tax or account settings can change the exact total.
subscriptionChange.lifetime.body: Switching to this one-time purchase does not refund or shorten your current subscription. You'll keep the access from your current plan until that subscription ends, then your new purchase applies.
subscriptionChange.pastDue.body: Your subscription is past due. Changing plans won't use proration: your new plan starts from today once payment succeeds.
subscriptionChange.scheduledPeriodEnd.bo: This change will take effect at the end of your current billing period. You keep your current plan and access until then.
subscriptionChange.slidingScale.nextCycl: New quantity applies on your next billing date. There's no charge or proration today.
